reviews.review: All the good parts of the previous EDF games. Some decent quality of life improvements
If I ever were to join the army, this game is what I'm gonna tell the drill sergeant why

Perfect casual filler game to play between other games, or if you're looking to pass a little bit of time. Missions generally last between 10 and 20 mins and don't really require much thought (Mindless fun), and the addictive loop of attempting to tackle harder missions in order to unlock better weapons, equipment and vehicles will keep you coming back time and time again.

[h1]Unhinged horde shooter with anime thighs[/h1]
Fantastic asset flip. Whoever conceived this franchise is a genius. This game speaks to the inner caveman in me who just wants to squash bugs and explode things.

[h1]Good:[/h1]
+ The game has good performance, until you get like 400 spiders at once and your CPU turns into gravy

+ Graphics are sufficient for the purposes of the game. I don't need AAA graphics to see the Wing Diver's thighs

+ English dub is genuine garbage but it adds so much charm to the game

+ Classes have good variety to them, every one feels pretty unique

+ Tons of content and missions to play through. Some are chill and relaxing, some will melt your brain

+ The soundtrack is hype. Especially the lobby soundtrack

+ The in-game communication system by far the most needlessly expansive one I've ever seen. I have tricked so many people into bringing radar equipment despite nobody using tracking weapons

+ The story of the game exists, but honestly it's not something you should care about

+ Epic battlefield scenarios the game puts you in. You sometimes feel like a god walking amongst men

+ I have no idea why but killing endless hordes of bugs is actually fun. This is a gameplay niche I never knew I needed filled before

+ You get some downright hilarious interactions with other players online. You'll be plowing through bugs, on a roll, then some guy start singing and everyone joins in. Really wholesome experience considering the theme of the game

[h1]Bad:[/h1]
- Ranger class exists purely to be dunked on by every other class. The only thing he is good for is doing sick doughnuts on your motorcycle in the middle of a firefight

- The upgrade system in this game will give you brainrot. Kill enemies to drop loot crates. Armour crates increase your armour value by an arbitrary figure that you gotta go look up online, and weapon crates have a [b]chance[/b] of giving you the weapon you want. For upgrades to that weapon, you then need to farm more crates and pray you get duplicates of it, and [b]pray[/b] those duplicates have better stats. Otherwise you ain't getting anything out of it. I've not seen a worse upgrade system in any other game before

- Online lobby system allows you to join a game that is currently in progress, but that just puts you in the lobby, not in the game itself. You then have to wait for the game to be done in order to wait for everyone to return to the lobby as well, before you can actually enter the game. It's as inconvenient as it sounds

- Single-player and multiplayer progress are tracked separately. This might seem good, but it really just takes up a lot of your time, since there are like 100+ missions and each mission can take upwards of 30 mins if you're a Ranger. They are also pretty much identical in every way, except that a few missions are not shared between the two game modes, so it's not even a different experience progressing through both sides of it

[h1]Overall: 8/10[/h1]
